accident_timeline.source_evidence: CCTV, Witness statements, RTO records, CDR, GPS data

events.event: Vikram Malhotra family leaves home for Malhotra Jewellers
Accused Ravi Shankar Yadav leaves his home in Rehgar Pura
Accused parks his Hero Splendor DL4SBK7890 on Ajmal Khan Road, 30m from Rishi Apartments
Accused removes helmet, walks towards Rishi Apartments
Accused enters Rishi Apartments main gate
Accused passes lobby, looks up towards staircase, proceeds to lift
Accused enters lift, presses button for 3rd floor
Accused reaches 3rd floor, walks towards Flat 302
Neighbor Sunita Kapoor hears footsteps on staircase
Accused uses iron rod to break Godrej padlock of Flat 302
events.source: Sunita Kapoor's loud sound observation, Physical evidence

events.event: Sunita Kapoor comes out, sees accused bending over door
Accused tells her he is from plumber's team, she returns inside
Accused enters Flat 302, begins ransacking
Accused moves to master bedroom, finds almirah locked
Accused uses iron rod to break almirah lock
Accused extracts gold ornaments, silver items, cash from almirah
Accused places items in black bag
Accused completes theft, prepares to leave
Accused exits main gate with black bag
Accused walks towards Ajmal Khan Road
Security guard Mahesh Kumar notices accused walking away
Accused starts his motorcycle and rides away
Sunita Kapoor calls Mahesh on intercom, alerts him
Mahesh Kumar inspects 3rd floor, finds broken padlock
Mahesh informs RWA Secretary Rajiv Chawla
Attempts made to call Malhotra family - unsuccessful
Malhotra family returns to Rishi Apartments
Family discovers broken padlock and ransacked flat
Sunita Kapoor comes out, tells family about seeing Ravi earlier
RWA Secretary arrives, briefed
PCR call made by Sunita Kapoor on 112
PCR van reaches spot, cordons off flat
Inspector Rajesh Kumar Yadav reaches spot
FIR No. 534/2024 registered at PS Karol Bagh
Forensic team arrives, spot panchnama begins
Seizure memo prepared, evidence collected
Statements of witnesses Sunita Kapoor and Mahesh recorded
Spot panchnama completed
CCTV footage analyzed, accused identified as Ravi Shankar Yadav
RTO verification of motorcycle DL4SBK7890 - owner confirmed as accused
Police team led by Inspector Rajesh reaches Rehgar Pura for search
Accused Ravi Shankar Yadav arrested at his residence
Accused medically examined at Safdarjung Hospital
Recovery of stolen items from accused's house in presence of witnesses
Detailed statement of accused recorded, admits to theft
FSL final report received confirming all forensic evidence
Investigation completed, chargesheet approved by ACP

accident_timeline.timeline_consistency_check: All times cross-verified with at least two independent sources. CCTV timestamps confirm witness statements. Timeline of 32 minutes inside building is consistent with the extent of ransacking observed. No contradictions found.
